in_marathi.name: Mehuli
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mehuli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mehuli is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana', meaning 'moon'. The name signifies the gentle and soothing light of the moon. It is also said to mean 'pleasing' or 'gracious'.
